key_difference: (D) drains the list in an unbounded `while (true)` loop with no `MaxPasses` cap, so an event whose destructor always posts a new event makes application exit hang forever, whereas (B) gives up after 16 passes with a warning; (D) also changes `fetchAndSubRelaxed` to `Acquire` in `clearEvents()` and unposts while holding the mutex, both of which reviewers questioned.
